summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Homeland Group iteration 16 features: Updates feed, Insights carousel, navbar changes, theme-aware logo, admin CRUD, project visibility/reorder, and appearance customization. All backend APIs (18/18) and frontend features passed successfully.

Backend: GET /api/updates returns only published updates, sorted pinned-first then date desc
Backend: Admin GET /api/admin/updates returns all updates
Backend: POST /api/admin/updates creates new update
Backend: PUT /api/admin/updates with link_type variants (none/project/external) persist correctly
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/updates removes update
Backend: GET /api/projects excludes visible:false projects
Backend: PUT /api/admin/projects/:id toggles visibility and persists
Backend: PUT /api/admin/projects/:id reorder persists correctly
Backend: PUT /api/admin/content persists theme settings (font_display, font_body, font_scale, gold, bg_dark, bg_light, hero_text)
Backend: GET /api/content returns persisted theme and site_logo_light
Frontend: Navbar has single 'Insights' link pointing to /updates
Frontend: Navbar has single 'Enquire Now' CTA button
Frontend: Navbar has NO 'Book Visit' button (correctly removed)
Frontend: Light mode logo swaps to /homeland-logo-dark.webp
Frontend: Home Insights carousel prev/next buttons work
Frontend: Home Insights carousel dots navigation works
Frontend: Home Insights carousel play/pause toggle works
Frontend: Home Insights carousel displays 5 cards correctly
Frontend: /updates page has all filter tabs (All/Updates/News/Media/Blog)
Frontend: /updates page tab filtering works correctly (All: 5 cards, Updates: 1, Blog: 2, News: 1, Media: 1)
Frontend: /updates page cards render with proper styling
Frontend: Admin Projects move up/down reorder buttons work and persist
Frontend: Admin Projects visibility toggle works and persists
Frontend: Admin Projects slider toggle works and persists
Frontend: Admin Updates create dialog opens and form fields work
Frontend: Admin Updates quick toggles (published/pinned) work and persist
Frontend: Admin Content Appearance tab font selects work (Heading, Body, Size)
Frontend: Admin Content Appearance tab color inputs work (Gold, Dark BG, Light BG, Hero Text)
Frontend: Admin Content Appearance Save Changes button persists settings
